status: implemented_targeted_verified; parser independent refinements and final integration pending
implementation: Only .docx links enter passive versioned document preview. Legacy .doc/.docm and presentations retain existing explicit external-open behavior. Refresh checks the exact current file receipt.
Same readonly renderer for every Agent; no new dependency or product environment flag. No remote fetching or executing document content.
Continuous body, separate headers/footers/notes, supported run/paragraph styles, list labels, bounded table windows with merged source ownership, local PNG/JPEG bytes. No Word pagination claim.

20 top blocks per page; paragraphs split at 1000 runs/40000 UTF-16 units without splitting surrogate pairs; tables show 20 rows by 12 columns, with bounded cell excerpts and explicit full-cell detail/focus return.

Per-file capture/parse AbortController plus operation ownership suppress stale/cancelled results. Hiding stops active frontend work and releases rendered resources; a completed exact-file parse may remain cached. No claim of cancelling the operating-system read.
Each displayed document owns a reference-counted image URL pool. Repeated references share one encoded resource; last visible consumer release revokes it, independently across files.
Outdents beyond preview start adapt to keep first characters reachable; ordinary hanging indents remain. Sizes/spacing adaptation is disclosed.
